sources.title: GitHub - openai/codex: Lightweight coding agent that runs in your ...
sources.snippet: Codex CLI is a coding agent from OpenAI that runs locally on your computer. If you want Codex in your code editor (VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf), install in your IDE.
